colors_v2_readiness.outcome: No commands sent; only five of six objects catalogued within the 100-second startup/observation window.

changes_supported_by_diagnostics: Capture interval 0.25 s and 15 degree viewpoint threshold avoid skipped views during rotation.
Camera rays transformed from image time to laser-scan time through odometry.
Warmup countdown starts at first nonzero ROS clock.
Shelf low deck lowered with matching visible/collision geometry so the laser does not pass underneath on a slightly pitched robot.
Colored tables changed from monochrome pedestals to four-legged work tables with visible gray lower frames.
Same-class retained instances compared in one gallery; gallery rejection does not fall back to forced per-view selection.
Near-target adapter keeps current position rather than reducing stand-off further.
navigation_caveat: The first color scene had one 60-second Nav2 timeout on person_1 after four successful color commands; selection was correct. Both person retries passed. Final four-leg-table scene completed all six commands without a progress error, but this does not establish a general cure for DWB local-planning stalls. Nav2 controller parameters were unchanged.
